summary: STUB FIXTURE. The patient administration system publishes HL7 v2.5 ADT messages as files, one message per file. The messages carry patient demographics (PID) and visit details (PV1) for registrations, admissions and discharges.

access.notes: Read-only folder. File names begin with the event timestamp, so sorted file-name order is event order.

entities.name: Patient
entities.description: Demographics repeated on every message for the patient. One patient appears in many messages; the latest message holds the current demographics.

entities.name: Visit
entities.source: PV1 segment; message types ADT^A01, ADT^A03, ADT^A04
entities.description: One visit is identified by the visit number in PV1.19. Outpatient and emergency visits arrive as a single A04. An inpatient stay arrives as A01 (admission, no discharge time) and later A03 (discharge), so the two must be merged on PV1.19.

relationships: Visit (PV1.19) -> Patient (PID.3.1) within the same message
data_quality_notes: There are more messages than distinct visit numbers: inpatient stays produce two messages.
Some A01 admissions have no matching A03 yet (patient still admitted).
open_questions: Can a visit be cancelled (A11/A13)? None are present in the sample feed.
Which timezone do the timestamps use?
